d: Deep purple, messy hair with long braided locks framing the face and a large black bow perched atop the head. Golden-yellow eyes with narrow, mischievous pupils set in a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build wearing an orange oversized coat over a white sleeveless romper, paired with chunky grey and black platform boots. Accessories include a golden hairclip, a small star-shaped earring, a gold star pendant, and a black slate held in the hand.
